connectionInterrupted: The connection to your TV dropped during installation ("connection reset by peer"). This usually isn't a problem with the app — it's almost always a VPN, proxy, or "secure DNS" app on this computer capturing the route to your TV, or an unstable Wi-Fi link. Try this, then install again: 1) turn off any VPN / tunnel / secure-DNS app, 2) connect the TV by Ethernet or move it closer to the router, 3) make sure this computer and the TV are on the same network.
vpnDetectedWarning: A VPN or tunnel adapter looks active ({0}). It can stop the app from finding your TV or break installs midway. If your TV isn't listed or installs fail, turn the VPN / proxy / secure-DNS app off and rescan.
TvNameNotFound: TV Name could not be found...
TvDuidNotFound: TV duid could not be found...
lblCustomIconHint: Optional. Pick a PNG to use as this app's launcher icon — remembered per app and written into the package at install. Leave empty to keep the default.
lblAppIconsHint: Optional. Give an app its own launcher icon — pick your own PNG, or the bundled 16:9 oblong tile (handy on Tizen 5.5 TVs) where available. The choice is remembered per app and written into the package at install.
lblAppTitleHint: Optional. Rename this app's launcher tile on the TV. Leave empty to keep the package's own name. Remembered per app and written into the package at install.
IpWindowDescription: Please enter the device's IP address:
InvalidDeviceIp: Invalid device IP or device not found.
lblIncludeBetaUpdates: Include beta versions in update checks
DeveloperModeRequired: Samsung TV is not in developer mode...
DeveloperIPMismatch: Samsung Developer mode IP doesn't match this devices local IP, do you wish to continue?
DeveloperIPReversed: IP is in reversed order on the TV, please re-enable developer mode and type your local IP in reversed order. (ex: 192.168.1.2 → 2.1.168.192)
DevNotReadyEnableDevMode: ⚠ TV detected, but Developer Mode is off. On the TV: open Apps, type 1 2 3 4 5, switch Developer Mode On, enter this PC's IP, restart the TV, then rescan.
DevNotReadyPowerCycle: ⚠ TV detected and Developer Mode is on, but its debug port isn't responding yet. Fully power-cycle the TV (unplug ~30s), then rescan.
DevNotReadyIpMismatch: ⚠ TV detected, but its Developer Mode IP doesn't match this PC. Re-enter this PC's IP in the TV's Developer Mode settings, power-cycle the TV, then rescan.
restartRequiredBody:
This TV has Developer Mode on, but its install service isn't running yet, so it can't be installed to until it's restarted.

• Press and hold the TV's power button until it fully shuts down, then turn it back on, or
• Unplug the TV from power for a minute or two, then plug it back in.

After it restarts, scan again and the TV will be ready.
NoDevicesFoundRetry: No devices found, retry with virtual NIC?
RetySearchMsg: No TV's found, want to search again with virtual network cards included in the search?
alreadyInstalled: {0} is already installed and your TV doesn't allow replacing or removing it remotely over the network connection. Please delete {0} on the TV (open the app list, press and hold the app, choose Remove) and try again.
modiyConfigRequired: Jellyfin app needs a new app id!
deleteExistingFailed: Deleting the existing version failed. Please delete it manually...
deleteExistingNotAllowed: Deletion not allowed. Enable the setting to allow the tool to remove the existing app...
insufficientSpace: Your device has insufficient space, please remove some apps and try again...
AuthorMismatch: Author Certificate mismatch, please re-sign the package with correct certificate.
certificateMismatch: {0} is already installed with a different signing certificate, so your TV won't replace it in place — and this TV doesn't allow removing apps remotely over the network connection. Please delete {0} on the TV manually (open the Apps list, press and hold {0}, choose Remove), then install it again.
certificateNotYetValid: Your signing certificate only becomes valid on {0}, and a Samsung TV refuses a package signed with a certificate whose validity period hasn't started yet. Nothing is wrong with the app or your TV — the install is held until the countdown below reaches zero. If that time looks wrong, this computer's clock is off: cancel, correct the date, time and time zone, then install again.
certificateCountdownCaption: Time until your certificate becomes valid
certificateCountdownReady: Your certificate is valid now — you can install.
certificateWaiting: Waiting for the signing certificate to become valid...
certificateWaitCancelled: Installation cancelled while waiting for the signing certificate to become valid.
apiVersionMismatch: Your TV refused this package (install error [118, -4], "operation not allowed"). This usually means one of two things: the app was built for a newer Tizen version than your TV, or the package needs Partner signing / a privilege your certificate doesn't grant. If other apps (for example Jellyfin) install on this TV just fine, it's this package — try turning on Partner signing in Settings and installing again, or use an older/compatible build of the app.
lblBasePathHint: Tip: Paste full URL (e.g., https://host.com/path/jellyfin) to auto-fill all fields
lblGitHubTokenHint: Optional. Prevents API rate limiting when fetching releases. Create one at GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens.
lblManualDuidsHint: Optional, advanced. Pre-authorize other Samsung TVs by their DUID (one per line) so a single signing certificate covers them — fewer Samsung logins when installing to multiple TVs.
duidLimitReached: A signing certificate can cover at most {0} TVs; device IDs beyond that were left out.
lblCssHint: Enter custom CSS or use @import to load external themes
lblJellyThemesHint: Click a theme to insert it and auto-validate. Visit the GitHub repo for previews.
lblUserSelectionHint: Selected users will be configured during installation
lblInstalledPluginsHint: Supported plugins will be transpiled and patched into the TV build. Untick any you don't want.
UpdateApplyingMessage: The application will restart to complete the update.
UpdateInstallerManagedWindows: This version was installed by an installer. Update it through winget (winget upgrade) or download the latest installer below.
UpdateInstallerManagedLinux: This version was installed via a system package. Update it with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt upgrade) or download the latest package below.
UpdateInstallerManagedMac: This version was installed as an app bundle. Update it through Homebrew (brew upgrade) or download the latest .dmg below.
IncompatiblePackage: Package version not compatible with device.
IncompatiblePackageDetailed: Package version {0} not compatible with Tizen OS {1}
lblMdnsWarning: Warning: You are using an mDNS hostname (.local). Samsung TVs cannot reliably resolve .local addresses, which may cause the server to appear as "undefined" on your TV — especially after network interruptions. Use a direct IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.100) instead for a stable connection.
lblJellyfinOnlyNotice: These settings apply ONLY to the official Jellyfin client — they are not supported for Jellyfin forks or other apps.
lblTvAppHint: Add your channel name and m3u8 link. These are written into TVApp before installation.
lblNoChannels: No channels yet. Click "Add channel" to create one.
lblTvAppOnlyNotice: These settings apply ONLY to TVApp — they are written into the package before installation.
lblTvAppOblongIconHint: Use the wide 16:9 launcher icon. Enable this for older Tizen 5.5 TVs that show a stretched or cropped square icon.
lblLitefinOnlyNotice: These settings apply ONLY to Litefin — they are written into the package before installation.
catalogSubtitle: Everything you can install on your Samsung device
catalogNoThumbnail: This app has no thumbnail yet.
lblPartnerSigningHint: Only for apps needing restricted privileges (e.g. VPN or DRM info). Turned on automatically when an app you install requires it. May be rejected by some TVs or accounts.
partnerSigningAutoEnabled: This app needs a Partner-level certificate, so Partner signing was turned on for you and a Partner certificate is being created. You can turn it back off in Settings.
lblBackupRestoreHint: Save your settings and signing certificates to a file, or restore them — to move between this PC, a Mac, or your phone.
lblRemoveLeftoverHint: Force-remove a leftover/partial install by package id
lblAutoDownloadUnavailable: (Automatic download unavailable - GitHub API rate limited)
hintForceSamsungLogin: Always sign in to Samsung and generate a fresh certificate, even when a reusable one already covers this TV. Normally off - leave it off unless signing is misbehaving.
hintCertificateType: Automatic uses Public, switching to Partner only when an app requires a restricted privilege (e.g. VPN); choose Public or Partner to force it. Certificates are created and reused automatically from your Samsung account (one per TV), so you're not asked to sign in every time. After importing a backup, this defaults to the imported certificate.
hintShareDebugLog: Export this session's debug log to send when reporting a problem.
hintServerUrl: Full address including http:// or https:// and the port. Include a base path too if you use a reverse proxy (e.g. https://media.example.com/jellyfin).
hintManageAppIcons: Give an app a custom launcher icon, applied when you install it.
hintCustomCss: Injected into the Jellyfin web client. Pick a community theme below, or write / paste your own CSS.
hintTvAppChannels: Name + stream URL (m3u8) pairs, written into the TVApp package's channel list when you install it. Order is the play order.
hintManualDuids: Optional, advanced. Pre-authorize other Samsung TVs by their DUID so a single signing certificate covers them - fewer Samsung logins when installing to multiple TVs.
hintGitHubToken: Optional. Prevents GitHub API rate limiting when fetching releases. Create one at GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens.
hintFixYoutubeTrailers: Patches the YouTube-trailers plugin so trailers play on Tizen instead of failing with error 153.
hintAppIconsPage: Pick an app from the list and give it a custom launcher icon (PNG) and/or a custom title. Both are applied to that package when you install it. Leave either empty to keep the package's default.
hintJellyfinSettingsPage: Point installed Jellyfin apps at your server and sign in once, so the TV app opens straight to your library. These settings are baked into the Jellyfin package when you install it.
hintBackup: Save your settings and signing certificates to a .zip you can move to another device, or restore from one. Certificates are restored immediately; restart the app to apply imported settings.
hintConfigureJellyfinServer: Set your Jellyfin server address and sign in once, baked into the Jellyfin app when you install it.
hintAutoLogin: Sign in to bake credentials into the package so the TV app skips the login screen. Leave blank to only set the server address.
hintCommunityThemes: Themes from github.com/kingchenc/JellyThemes - selecting one replaces the CSS with its @import.
hintBetaUpdates: When on, the in-app update check offers new beta versions and downloads them. Turn off to only be notified about stable releases.
hintMdnsAddress: ⚠️ .local (mDNS) addresses are often unreliable on Samsung TVs. Prefer the server's IP address if you can.
hintLanguage: The app's language. Every screen switches over straight away. Strings a translator hasn't reached yet stay in English.
statusCatalogUnavailable: Couldn't load the app list - you can still install a custom .wgt.
statusCatalogEmpty: No apps loaded (offline or GitHub rate-limited). Add a token in Settings, or install a custom .wgt.
statusCatalogPartial: Ready - but {0} of {1} app sources failed (likely GitHub rate limit). Add a GitHub token in Settings.
statusInvalidIp: That doesn't look like a valid IP address.
statusSelectTvFirst: Select a TV first (tap refresh to scan).
statusSelectAppFirst: Select an app and version first.
statusInstalledOpenApps: Installed {0}. Open the TV's Apps list to launch it.
statusEnterUsername: Enter a username to sign in (or just leave the server URL set).
statusNoLogFile: No log file is available for this session yet.
lblRemotePower: Power (turns the TV off; a sleeping TV is woken automatically)
lblRemoteTextHint: Focus a text field on the TV first. Not every model accepts typed text.
lblRemoteTextLiveHint: Focus a text field on the TV first, then just type - it appears there as you go. Not every model accepts typed text.
lblRemoteTextCleared: Cleared the field on the TV.
lblRemotePairPrompt: Accept the prompt on the TV to pair this computer.
lblRemotePairFailed: Pairing wasn't accepted. Use the reconnect button to try again.
lblRemoteNoChannel: Couldn't open the remote channel on this TV.
lblRemoteNotConnected: Not connected - use the reconnect button.
lblRemoteKeyFailed: That press didn't get through. The TV may have gone to standby.
lblRemoteTextFailed: The TV didn't take the text. Is a text field focused?
lblRemoteWakeNoMac: No answer from the TV. Switch it on with its own remote once, then this page can wake it.
lblRemoteWakeFailed: The TV didn't wake. Check "Power On with Mobile" in its network settings.
lblRemoteNoAnswerNoMac: No answer. Switch the TV on with its own remote once, then this page can wake it.
lblToolboxOwnerNote: For a TV you own. Everything here goes over the network, so no Developer Mode is needed - the TV only has to be awake.
lblToolboxSequencesHint: Key combinations from Samsung's own installation manuals, sent with exact timing - which a flaky infrared remote, or a Smart Remote with no number pad, cannot manage.
lblToolboxGapHint: Raise it if the TV misses a press, lower it if the combination times out.
lblToolboxStandbyNote: The factory and service combinations have to start from standby, and a sleeping TV doesn't serve this channel at all - those two still need the physical remote.
lblToolboxSeqHotelOptionDesc: The hotel/institution menu on a hospitality set, where hospitality mode is switched off. Put the TV on a live TV source first.
lblToolboxSeqHotelOptionAltDesc: The same combination ending in Power, which is what some models want.
lblToolboxSeqPowerCaveat: Ends with Power: a set that doesn't recognise the combination simply switches off.
lblToolboxSeqFactoryDesc: The factory menu. Starts from standby, so it can't be sent from here.
lblToolboxSeqServiceDesc: The service menu. Starts from standby, so it can't be sent from here.
lblToolboxSeqDelivered: {0}: all {1} presses delivered. Watch the TV to see whether it took them - the channel can't tell us.
lblToolboxSeqStopped: {0}: stopped at press {1} of {2}, which the TV didn't take.
lblToolboxAppsHint: Launching by ID reaches apps the TV's own launcher hides - hospitality, regional and pre-installed ones. The TV does not have to list an app for it to open. (Installed apps, over Developer Mode, is the list of what is really installed.)
lblToolboxAppsOffline: Showing the built-in app list - the online catalogue couldn't be reached.
lblToolboxLaunchSent: Sent the launch for {0}. This TV doesn't report which app is running, so check the screen.
lblToolboxLaunchFailed: Couldn't launch {0} - the TV took none of the three launch paths.

statusDebugDetachedAppRunning: Detached. {0} is still running on the TV.

statusImportedDesktop: Imported settings + {0} certificate file(s). Restart the app to apply.

statusUpdateAvailableApk: {0} is available (you have v{1}). Download the new APK?
statusNoTvsFoundHint: No TVs found. Enable Developer Mode on the TV and refresh, or tap the TV list to enter an IP manually.
statusSignInFailedCheck: Sign-in failed. Check the server URL and credentials.
statusSignedIn: Signed in - auto-login will be baked into the package.
statusSignedInTo: Signed in to {0} - auto-login will be baked into the package.
statusImportedMobile: Imported settings + {0} certificate file(s). Certificates are already restored. Restart the app to fully apply the imported settings.
lblSamsungAccountNoEmailTitle: Samsung account has no email address
statusSamsungAccountNoEmail: Your Samsung account doesn't have an email address on it, and the signing certificate can't be created without one. Open account.samsung.com, add and verify an email address, then try again.
